us.title: Laughing at Trump's hair is fun — but it's also a trap: NYT columnist
us.description: In a thought-provoking guest essay published in The New York Times , veteran columnist Frank Bruni delivers a sharp, analytical critique of the public and media's persistent fixation on Donald Trump’s physical appearance. Bruni argues that this ongoing, near-obsessive focus on cosmetics and aesthetics serves as a dangerous, counterproductive distraction from the severe institutional, legal, and democratic harm caused throughout Trump’s political career. By constantly reducing a highly consequential and deeply destructive political leader to a mere caricature—characterized by discussions of orange skin makeup, shifting hair colors, and distinct physical mannerisms—society inadvertently trivializes the profound gravity of his actions. This superficial approach ultimately lowers the bar for true political accountability, transforming serious questions of governance into a shallow cultural spectacle. Bruni highlights how late-night television monologues , political cartoons, and viral social media commentary frequently center their primary critiques on Trump’s physical presentation rather than his policy outcomes. While these superficial jabs and aesthetic jokes offer quick entertainment and momentary emotional relief for his detractors, they construct a misleading, circus-like atmosphere around American politics. This constant focus on appearance crowds out rigorous, substance-driven journalism. Instead of deeply analyzing complex policy implications, landmark judicial appointments, international foreign relations, or the systemic erosion of foundational democratic norms, public discourse becomes saturated with shallow internet memes and playground insults. Bruni notes that this troubling dynamic plays directly into a broader, worrisome cultural shift where political entertainment increasingly supersedes civic responsibility and critical thinking. Furthermore, the essay emphasizes that treating a prominent political figure like a cartoon villain minimizes the tangible, long-term consequences of his administration's official decisions. When the media and the public spend more collective energy debating a politician's physical signs of aging, posture, or tailoring choices than analyzing their actual legislative rollbacks, executive orders, or rhetoric, the true stakes of democratic governance are entirely lost. This aesthetic focus allows the substantive, everyday impact on citizens' lives to fade into the background. Bruni strongly urges critics, journalists, and the electorate to move past this counterproductive fixation. He calls for a collective, disciplined refocus on the substantive realities of Trump's political record, urging a return to serious, policy-oriented critique that addresses the fundamental challenges facing the nation's democratic institutions. Ultimately, Bruni's piece serves as an urgent warning that safeguarding democracy requires citizens to look far past the superficial spectacle, disregard the trivial aesthetic distractions, and directly confront the actual exercise of political power and its enduring institutional legacy.

gb.title: Rimmel's Beloved Foundation Has Just Been Improved To Match Every Undertone, And It's On Sale Now
gb.description: Rimmel The 2010s might have been a time for in your face, full-beat glam, but in 2026, we’re all about no-makeup makeup. But as anyone who’s rocked a ‘barely there’ makeup look will know, it takes a lot of effort to look so effortless. If you’re not one of those lucky people who’s blessed with perfect skin, you’ll know the struggle of finding a good base that doesn’t make you look like you’ve walked straight out of a noughties commercial (cakey) or come back from an extremely sunny holiday (not matched to your skin). Even though we live in an era of endless beauty choices, it can still be tricky to find a foundation that perfectly matches your skin. I don’t know about anyone else, but so often I’ve found one that I think perfectly matches my skin tone, only for me to get home and discover that something is just not quite right. On a mission to solve my particular crutch, Rimmel has updated the formula for its cult favourite Perfect Match Foundation so that it exactly matches every undertone and skin shade out there. Although Rimmel already boasted an impressive range of 16 different foundation shades, it only had one foundation formula for each shade. Now, though, it’s expanded its entire range to 22 blendable shades , each coded so that you can find a formula, whether you have warm, neutral, or cool undertones. According to Rimmel, this means the foundation really does provide a perfect match for 99% of skin tones. But that doesn’t mean its classic formula has changed – the foundation still provides the same blendable, medium coverage as before. As someone who always worries about foundation looking too cakey, Rimmel’s formula truly looks like your skin but better. It not only blurs your pores, but it doesn’t leave you looking dry and matte after you’ve applied it, as it can keep your skin hydrated for up to 24 hours. That’s not the only benefit it has, though, because it’s also loaded with SPF20, to keep your skin fresh for longer. And it turns out, I’m not the only one impressed by the update: 89% of testers agree it smooths the skin, while 83% say it feels weightless all day. I’ve somehow omitted the best part of all of this, which is that you don’t have to break the bank to get Rimmel’s foundation, because it’s on sale for just £7.99 , down from £9.99, right now. So stock up while you can! How do you figure out what undertones your skin has? If you’re wondering WTF all of this means, don’t worry, I’ve got you. Figuring out what undertones you have couldn’t be easier – it’s all to do with the colour of your veins. Stand by an open window, and If you have blue or purple veins, you’ll likely have cool toned skin . Green veins mean you have warm undertones, and a mix of both means you have neutral undertones. fr.title: Esteban Ocon avant le GP d'Azerbaïdjan de F1 : "Les erreurs peuvent coûter cher"
fr.description: Esteban Ocon espère poursuivre sa série de bons Grands Prix ce week-end pour le GP d'Azerbaïdjan de F1 2026. Il se méfie toutefois des caractéristiques de ce circuit urbain qui oscille entre longues lignes droites, gros freinages et les murs de la cité de Bakou qui ne pardonnent pas la moindre erreur. Le pilote français se montre plus enthousiasme sur les performances de sa Haas depuis quelques semaines. Certes, il n'a plus marqué de points depuis le GP de Monaco début juin mais les évolutions apportées semblent convaincre Esteban Ocon : "Nous sommes actuellement sur une série de courses encourageante, durant laquelle nous travaillons bien, la voiture se montre régulière et les évolutions apportées remplissent leur rôle". Esteban Ocon se méfie des pièges de Bakou S'il ne se fixe pas d'objectif pour la course de samedi, Esteban Ocon se méfie des caractéristiques du circuit urbain de Bakou. Un tracé qui ne pardonne pas la moindre erreur mais qui pourrait offrir des opportunités en course en cas de voiture de sécurité ou de drapeau rouge. "Bakou est encore un superbe circuit, avec un tour à la fois excitant et exigeant où, un peu comme à Madrid, il faut monter progressivement en rythme au fil des séances, car les erreurs peuvent coûter cher. J’ai hâte de commencer". Trois Grands Prix en trois week-ends, un véritable défi pour le pilote Haas Mais ce Grand Prix d'Azerbaïdjan est aussi le premier d'une série de trois Grands Prix en trois week-ends : Azerbaïdjan, Malaisie et Singapour. Un véritable défi physique et mental pour Esteban Ocon et son équipe : "À l’approche de cette nouvelle série de trois Grands Prix consécutifs, il sera essentiel de bien se préparer, de se reposer et de conserver le bon état d’esprit, et cela vaut pour toute l’équipe. C’est aussi une excellente occasion de passer trois semaines ensemble, car cela permet vraiment de trouver un rythme de travail, et à ce stade de la saison, nous nous connaissons tous très bien".

es.title: El penalti que la tele no enseñó y echa más leña al fuego del derbi
es.description: El derbi madrileño del estadio Metropolitano, que acabó con victoria del Atlético frente a un Real Madrid que se quejó de la actuación arbitral (2-1), se ha encontrado este lunes con un nuevo capítulo. Un vídeo grabado desde la grada del coliseo rojiblanco, en el que se puede ver un claro penalti de Pubill antes del descanso , ha echado más leña al fuego después de saltar a las redes sociales. La acción, que habría resultado tan decisiva como las dos tarjetas rojas que el colegiado Ortiz Arias no mostró a los locales Romero y Kang-in Lee , pasó desapercibida en la retransmisión televisiva, donde ni siquiera fue repetida. Sobre el minuto 40 Kylian Mbappé dispara desde la esquina del área y Marc Pubill, en un gesto reflejo, mueve el brazo para interceptar la pelota. Ni el colegiado madrileño del partido, ni el VAR, ni quienes seguían el encuentro por televisión pudieron ver la infracción. Las imágenes muestran que el defensor del Atlético espera el disparo del atacante francés del Real Madrid con los brazos ocultos tras el cuerpo. Sin embargo, en el momento del chut Pubill mueve el brazo derecho hacia el balón, cortando la trayectoria del disparo. Ese movimiento, unido al hecho de que el brazo ocupa un espacio no natural hace que la acción sea sancionable . En el vídeo se aprecia cómo Vinicius, el único jugador madridista en la zona, protesta inmediatamente alzando los brazos ante Ortiz Arias, aunque sus gestos no influyeron para nada en el colegiado madrileño.

mx.title: Tormenta Tropical Polo podría reforzar lluvias en Sonora
mx.description: La a ctividad de varios sistemas tropicales e n el Pacífico mantiene la atención meteorológica sobre Sonora, principalmente por la cantidad de humedad que podrían aportar al monzón de verano durante los próximos días. Este lunes 21 de septiembre, la Tormenta Tropical Polo se encuentra frente a las costas del Pacífico mexicano y es el sistema que genera mayor interés para Sonora, debido a que algunos escenarios contemplan posibles efectos sobre la entidad hacia el 28 o 29 de septiembre . Polo podría convertirse en huracán mayor En entrevista exclusiva de este lunes en Expreso 24/7 con Marcelo Beyliss, el especialista en meteorología Carlos Arias explicó que Polo se encontraba por la mañana a unos 410 kilómetros al sur-sureste de Manzanillo , Colima , y a 320 kilómetros al suroeste de Zihuatanejo, Guerrero. El sistema se desplaza hacia el oriente a una velocidad aproximada de 7 km/h sobre aguas con temperaturas de entre 30 y 31°C. El especialista señaló que las condiciones del océano favorecen una intensificación rápida , el pronóstico contempla que pueda convertirse en huracán durante este lunes , e incluso alcanzar posteriormente una categoría mayor . MeteoAlert, por su parte, destacó que uno de los escenarios contempla que alcance la categoría 5 . Arias explicó que, por ahora, se prevé que el ciclón avance paralelo a las costas nacionales sin ingresar directamente al territorio. Sin embargo, su tamaño y la humedad asociada podrían tener otro efecto relevante para Sonora: reforzar el monzón de verano . MeteoAlert señaló que entre los escenarios actualmente contemplados también existe la opción de que sea desplazado hacia mar abierto por la interacción con otro sistema tropical. Por ello, el periodo que permanece bajo vigilancia es del 27 al 30 de septiembre . Protección Civil indicó que, de presentarse efectos en la entidad, estos podrían estar relacionados con un incremento de humedad, nubosidad, oleaje y potencial de precipitaciones. La dependencia mantiene vigilancia constante sobre el sistema y recomienda consultar las actualizaciones oficiales antes de tomar decisiones relacionadas con posibles impactos. Otro ciclón tropical también aportaría humedad Durante la entrevista, Arias también habló de Odalis , otro sistema tropical ubicado mucho más lejos de las costas de Sonora. Este lunes alrededor de las 8:00 de la mañana, se encontraba aproximadamente a 2 mil 275 kilómetros al suroeste de Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur , desplazándose hacia el noroeste a unos 19 km/h. El meteorólogo explicó que Odalis también podría intensificarse y posteriormente modificar su trayectoria debido a una corriente en chorro ubicada al noroeste de México. Aunque se encontraría con aguas más frías hacia el final de la semana, provocando que pierda fuerza, su humedad también podría contribuir al fortalecimiento del monzón sobre Sonora. Existe además un sistema frente a las costas de Guatemala con 40% de probabilidad de desarrollo , cuyas condiciones podrían permitir que evolucione a depresión tropical durante los siguientes días. Otro sistema , ubicado a casi 3 mil kilómetros de distancia, presenta actualmente una probabilidad de 80% de desarrollo ciclónico en los próximos dos o tres días; sin embargo, se desplazaría más lejos de las costas mexicanas, por lo que no representa por ahora una preocupación para nuestro estado.

in.title: Kalinga ghat in Odisha to remain closed for two days amid landslide risk
in.description: In view of the possibility of heavy rain triggered by a low-pressure system over the Bay of Bengal , the Kalinga Ghat in Odisha will remain closed to vehicular traffic for two days on September 23 and 24. The decision has been taken as a precautionary measure due to the risk of landslides and falling rocks along the ghat road. Traffic between Ganjam and Kandhamal through the Kalinga Ghat will remain suspended during the two-day period. Ganjam Collector Keerthi Vasan said vehicles will be allowed to use alternative routes. Fire Services, ODRAF Teams Put On Alert The administration has also identified the Chikiti and Patrapur areas of Ganjam as vulnerable to landslides. Fire Services and ODRAF teams have been kept ready in both locations to respond to any emergency. The Ganjam administration is coordinating with the Kandhamal district administration to monitor the situation and take necessary measures, the Collector said. Also Read: Low-pressure area over BoB to intensify, Odisha braces for heavy rain Previous Landslide Raises Concern The precautionary measure assumes significance as a major landslide occurred at Kalinga Ghat on September 16 last year. It took around one-and-a-half months to clear the debris, during which vehicular movement through the ghat remained completely suspended. The road has still not been restored to its earlier width and is currently around 15 feet wide as a temporary arrangement. Large boulders continue to remain lodged on the affected hillside, raising concerns that heavy rain could trigger further rockfalls and landslides.

sg.title: Huawei Launches the AI Practice LAB (AIPL) Solution, Setting a New Paradigm for "Education + AI" Talent Cultivation
sg.description: SHANGHAI , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- During HUAWEI CONNECT 2026, the Global Education Summit themed "AI × Education: Building the Talent Foundation for the Digital & Intelligent Era" was successfully held in Shanghai. At the summit, Huawei officially launched the AI Practice LAB (AIPL) Solution globally, and simultaneously released the "AI+ Practical Teaching White Paper" (referred to as the "White Paper"). As AI-driven education transformation gains momentum, the conventional theoretical teaching model can no longer meet the industry's demand for practical capabilities, making AI talent cultivation a top priority for higher education. Drawing on its extensive experience across various industries, Huawei has introduced the AIPL Solution, which is centered around real-world scenarios, real data, and real algorithms. This solution aims to bridge the gap between conventional theoretical teaching and industry needs by introducing real-world industry cases, anonymized data, and engineering tools into teaching practices, helping universities cultivate AI professionals who are truly aligned with industry needs. Tao Jingwen, Deputy Chairman of the Supervisory Board, Huawei, noted that together with the education sector and industry enterprises, Huawei have integrated AI technology to jointly deepen our exploration of practical education models. We have built "roads" and "bridges" in theoretical learning, practice, and scientific research innovation. Huawei will continue to remain deeply rooted in the education sector, adopting an open approach to collaborate with global universities, research institutions, and industry partners, empowering the digital and intelligent transformation of the education sector through technological innovation. Launch of the AIPL Solution At the summit, Li Junfeng, Vice President of Huawei and CEO of Global Public Sector BU; Pang Chuanchun, Director of Huawei's Learning & Certification Services Dept; He Lian, Vice President of Wuhan University; Xue Guangtao, Director of Network & Information Center of Shanghai Jiao Tong University jointly launched the Huawei AIPL Solution to the world. Currently, in collaboration with 12 baseline partners, the solution has been used to build AI practical teaching solutions and has been deployed at multiple universities, including Beijing Institute of Technology and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. This global launch aims to promote the concept and solution of AI practice worldwide, fostering the cultivation of AI innovation talents globally. At the summit, Huawei, together with multiple universities and partners, released the "AI+ Practical Teaching White Paper". sg.description: Built on the financial-grade open-source agent platform openJiuwen and open compute infrastructure, Huawei builds Agent Factory, Token Factory, and Data-Knowledge Factory to accelerate production-grade agent deployment at scale. SHANGHAI , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- During HUAWEI CONNECT 2026, Huawei hosted a Global Finance Summit. Jason Cao, CEO of Huawei Digital Finance BU, delivered a keynote titled "Owning Your AI, Advancing Agentic Banking," presenting the proposition "Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence" to global financial customers and launching the Huawei Fintelligent AI Solution worldwide. The solution focuses on key challenges facing large-scale AI deployment in the global financial industry, including security, scalability, and sustainability. It helps financial institutions build a new capability system and, through three intelligent factories — Agent Factory, Token Factory, and Data-Knowledge Factory — continuously build and evolve their enterprise AI architecture, one-stop agent foundation, banking domain intelligence, and full-lifecycle Token operations, accelerating the transition to Agentic Finance. Jason Cao said, "Competition in financial AI is shifting from model capability to enterprise-wide AI system capability. Every financial institution should own its AI and keep the choice and evolution of AI in its own hands. Truly owning your AI is not about using a particular model or deploying a few AI applications. It means being able to choose independently, operate securely, replicate at scale, and continuously evolve your AI capabilities. Through open architecture, platforms, and compute, Huawei will work with customers and partners to bring AI at scale into core business operations and accelerate the transition to Agentic Finance." Jason Cao, CEO of Huawei Digital Finance BU Agent Factory scales AI into an enterprise-wide capability; Token Factory delivers a better price-performance ratio and sustainable full-lifecycle Token management; and Data-Knowledge Factory accumulates knowledge assets to enable financial institutions to build intelligence as an internal capability. Together, the three intelligent factories connect data, knowledge, Tokens, and agent capabilities. Agent Factory focuses on helping banks build, run, and manage agents at scale, enabling AI capabilities to move from isolated applications to enterprise-wide intelligence while supporting the accumulation, reuse, and unified management of agent assets. openJiuwen is an open-source agent platform designed for multi-agent collaboration, with enterprise-grade reliability and compute affinity. Built on a financial-grade production kernel, it provides three core capabilities: stable long-running operations, financial-grade components, and one-stop development and operations. openJiuwen provides a unified enterprise foundation, enabling financial institutions to build, run, manage, and govern agents on the same agent platform. Huawei launched TokeNexus, a full-lifecycle Token operations solution covering Token planning, efficient production, intelligent scheduling, and global optimization, enabling unified operations and management across the entire Token lifecycle. Through end-to-end integrated governance, TokeNexus helps financial institutions scale AI while keeping costs controllable, performance reliable, and supply sustainable. Huawei proposes the Data-Knowledge Factory, which transforms bank data, documents, and rules into knowledge that agents can understand, trust, and invoke, gradually accumulating it into each bank's own Domain Intelligence. At the summit, Huawei launched the Financial Agentic Data Solution. Centered on data and knowledge pipelines, the solution provides financial agents with high-quality data and knowledge, allowing high-value data and knowledge to flow continuously to agents. Building on this evolution, the Data-Knowledge Factory establishes a systematic upgrade path from data supply to knowledge supply. Huawei's AI Coding Solution adopts an ontology-centric approach to transform valuable business rules hidden in legacy-system code into reusable knowledge assets that AI can understand and use, accelerating core modernization. At the summit, Huawei also joined representatives from banking, insurance, securities, and industry partners to unveil the 2026 Huawei Global Financial Lighthouse, highlighting nine lighthouse practices and providing reference cases for digital and intelligent transformation across the global financial industry. Huawei has been deeply engaged in the financial industry for 16 years. sg.title: Tesla Reopens Roadster Reservations for $50,000 USD Ahead of an October 1 Reveal
sg.description: Summary Tesla has reopened orders for its next-generation Roadster, requiring a massive $50,000 USD deposit weeks before the vehicle's official unveilingThe October 1 event in Texas is set to feature a hovering, remote-operated stunt car equipped with SpaceX cold gas thrustersThe fresh round of reservations arrives despite the original 2017 Roadster suffering at least eight delays without delivering a single production unit The Tesla Roadster is officially back on the order books, and securing a spot in line requires a massive injection of blind faith. During the week of September 20, the automaker quietly reopened reservations for its next-generation electric hypercar, asking buyers to commit heavy funds before a final production version has even been shown. Claiming a reservation requires a steep $50,000 USD deposit initiated by a fully refundable $5,000 USD credit card payment and locked in by a $45,000 USD wire transfer that must be completed within 10 days. The reservation portal went live approximately two weeks ahead of a highly anticipated October 1 reveal event scheduled near Waco, Texas, where the company states it will finally outline official pricing, hardware specifications and production targets.By demanding an immediate five-figure commitment for an unseen silhouette, the automaker tests the limits of its own brand loyalty against a notoriously fractured track record. This marks the second time the company has collected $50,000 USD deposits for the Tesla Roadster following a November 2017 push that also offered a $250,000 USD Founders Series option requiring total payment upfront. That original 2017 iteration was promised for production in 2020 but has since suffered at least eight separate delays without putting a single unit on the road in nearly nine years. Making matters more complex for early adopters, the company has previously made it difficult for high-profile reservation holders, including tech creator Marques Brownlee and OpenAI executive Sam Altman, to successfully receive refunds on canceled preorders.The upcoming October 1 showcase aims to reset the narrative by swapping outdated concepts for a stark aesthetic overhaul. Recent teasers indicate the new iteration will abandon older curves for a sharp redesign that heavily incorporates angular Cyber styling complete with a modern full-width light bar. This updated aesthetic attempts to eclipse the massive promises made back in 2017 when the vehicle was pitched with a $200,000 base price, a 620-mile battery range, a top speed pushing past 250 mph and a scorching 0-60 mph time of under 1.9 seconds.To sell the radically updated vision, CEO Elon Musk has teased an extravagant live demonstration for the Tesla Roadster built around SpaceX designed cold gas thrusters that he claims will allow the car to physically hover or fly. However, this thruster-equipped stunt car is expected to be entirely remote-operated, will not be street legal and could command a standalone price tag in the hundreds of thousands of dollars on its own. Musk explicitly stated at the All-In Summit that a live audience is required for the Texas event so attendees can personally vouch that the physics-defying demonstration is not generated by AI. Despite the theatrical push, the broader market remains skeptical of an imminent launch. Prediction contracts on Polymarket currently estimate a less than 5 percent chance of the vehicle reaching customers by the end of 2026 and project a 61 percent chance for actual 2027 deliveries. sg.title: Arctech Earns 2026 EcoVadis Silver Medal, Placing Among Top 15% Globally
sg.description: KUNSHAN, China , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Arctech has been awarded a Silver Medal in the 2026 EcoVadis Sustainability Rating, placing the company among the top 15% of companies assessed by EcoVadis globally. The recognition reflects Arctech's continued efforts to strengthen sustainability management and integrate environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles into its business and operations. Arctech receives the EcoVadis Silver Medal in the 2026 Sustainability Rating. EcoVadis assesses companies across four key sustainability themes: Environment, Labor & Human Rights, Ethics, and Sustainable Procurement. Its medals are awarded based on a company's percentile ranking among companies assessed globally over the previous 12 months, with the Silver Medal corresponding to the top 15%. Guided by its development approach of "globalization, differentiation, sustainability and intelligence", Arctech continues to advance ESG integration across its operations and business activities. On the environmental front, Arctech combines sustainable solutions with ongoing efforts to improve the environmental performance of its own operations. Through its "Tracker+" and "Green Power+" solutions, the company integrates solar tracking, flexible cable mounting, intelligent O&M, smart installation and energy storage to support diverse applications and the evolving needs of the energy transition. In 2025, Arctech invested RMB 4.3629 million (approximately US$651,000) in environmental protection. Its self-owned photovoltaic power stations generated more than 34 million kWh of electricity, accounting for 24% of its total electricity consumption. The company also continued to expand renewable energy use, improve energy efficiency across its facilities, and apply digital and intelligent technologies in manufacturing, saving 364,000 kWh of electricity annually. Beyond its environmental efforts, Arctech continues to strengthen its social and governance practices. The company holds certifications including ISO 45001, SA8000 and ISO 37001, supporting its efforts in occupational health and safety, employee rights and business ethics. The EcoVadis Silver Medal recognizes Arctech's progress to date and provides further momentum for continuous improvement. Looking ahead, Arctech will continue to deepen ESG integration, advance greener operations and sustainable solutions, and work with customers and partners to support the global energy transition. ph.title: Tardiness, absenteeism in far-flung Mati City school drops
ph.description: MATI CITY – A far-flung school in Mati City, Davao Oriental, registered a sharp drop in tardiness, absenteeism, and dropout rates over the past four school years. School officials partly attributed this to two school buses donated by a mining company. The Macambol National High School (MNHS) Performance Trend report covering school years 2022-2023 to 2025-2026 showed that the tardiness rate dropped from 12.5 percent in 2022-2023 to 0.8 percent in 2025-2026, a 93.6 percent decrease. MNHS Principal Jonathan Dizon said it initially increased to 13.2 percent in 2023-2024 then declined to 0.8 percent by the end of the reporting period. Chronic absenteeism also declined from 8.5 percent in 2022-2023 to 1.03 percent in 2025-2026, an 87.9 percent reduction. It fell to 7.2 percent in 2023-2024 and four percent in the succeeding school year. The school's dropout rate decreased from 7.5 percent to one percent, an 86.7 percent reduction in the past four years. Dizon cited the improvements to several factors, including the donation by Hallmark Mining Corp. in 2025 of two dedicated school buses. He said these transport more than 200 high school students daily, particularly those from distant barangays who had to walk long distances or rely on unreliable transportation to get to school. "Before the school buses, many of our students faced grueling daily commutes just to reach the campus," Dizon said. He added that long travel distances and limited transportation options contributed to students arriving late, missing classes, and, in some cases, dropping out. "The transportation support from Hallmark removed that massive barrier. It's really a big help to our students," he said. According to Dizon, students who take the school buses arrive less fatigued and are more prepared to participate in classes. These buses also provide students with safer transportation, particularly during adverse weather conditions, the school official said. Dizon said the improved attendance and retention rates have strengthened their efforts to keep learners in school and support their academic development. MNHS, Dizon said, has adopted the motto, "Every Learner Matters. No One Left Behind," while its attendance campaign has the theme "Attend Today, Learn More, Achieve Tomorrow." The school's performance report also carries the slogan, "Stronger Attendance, Brighter Futures." Dizon said school administrators and faculty hope the gains in attendance and retention will continue through the succeeding school years, as the school and community work to address barriers to education.

ph.title: Huawei Launches the AI Practice LAB (AIPL) Solution, Setting a New Paradigm for "Education + AI" Talent Cultivation
ph.description: SHANGHAI , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- During HUAWEI CONNECT 2026, the Global Education Summit themed "AI × Education: Building the Talent Foundation for the Digital & Intelligent Era" was successfully held in Shanghai. Drawing on its extensive experience across various industries, Huawei has introduced the AIPL Solution, which is centered around real-world scenarios, real data, and real algorithms. This solution aims to bridge the gap between conventional theoretical teaching and industry needs by introducing real-world industry cases, anonymized data, and engineering tools into teaching practices, helping universities cultivate AI professionals who are truly aligned with industry needs. Tao Jingwen, Deputy Chairman of the Supervisory Board, Huawei, noted that together with the education sector and industry enterprises, Huawei have integrated AI technology to jointly deepen our exploration of practical education models. We have built "roads" and "bridges" in theoretical learning, practice, and scientific research innovation. Huawei will continue to remain deeply rooted in the education sector, adopting an open approach to collaborate with global universities, research institutions, and industry partners, empowering the digital and intelligent transformation of the education sector through technological innovation. Launch of the AIPL Solution At the summit, Li Junfeng, Vice President of Huawei and CEO of Global Public Sector BU; Pang Chuanchun, Director of Huawei's Learning & Certification Services Dept; He Lian, Vice President of Wuhan University; Xue Guangtao, Director of Network & Information Center of Shanghai Jiao Tong University jointly launched the Huawei AIPL Solution to the world. Currently, in collaboration with 12 baseline partners, the solution has been used to build AI practical teaching solutions and has been deployed at multiple universities, including Beijing Institute of Technology and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. This global launch aims to promote the concept and solution of AI practice worldwide, fostering the cultivation of AI innovation talents globally. ph.title: Philippines needs ₱1.1-trillion investments to avert water security risks by 2040—OECD
ph.description: The Philippines needs about ₱1.07 trillion in water and sanitation investments through 2030 as mounting demand, fragmented regulation, as well as financially weak service providers threaten the country’s long-term water security, according to the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD). In a report published on Monday, Sept. 21, Paris-based OECD warned that without decisive action, growing pressure on the country’s water resources could create significant water security challenges in parts of the Philippines by 2040. The study, titled “Strengthening Economic Regulation of Water and Sanitation Services in the Philippines,” was prepared by OECD and Asia Water Council (AWC) following a National Dialogue on Water conducted from September 2024 to December 2025. Demand for water and sanitation services in the country is rising rapidly due to population growth, urbanization, recurrent floods, typhoons, as well as El Niño-related droughts, OECD noted. OECD said achieving universal access to safe water supply and sanitation by 2030, as envisioned under the Philippine Water Supply and Sanitation Master Plan (PWSSMP), would require about $18 billion, equivalent to ₱1.07 trillion, in investments between 2020 and 2030. While access has improved, structural problems remain, particularly fragmented regulation, inconsistent tariff-setting, weak financial capacity among many providers, and inadequate water-sector data, OECD said. The report cited data showing that 92 percent of Filipinos had access to safe water as of 2020, but about nine million people, or the remaining eight percent of the population, still lacked access. Water services are also highly fragmented, with more than 28,000 service providers nationwide. Roughly 20 percent of providers serve 60 percent of the population, while the remaining 80 percent serve just over a third, the report noted. Many of the smaller private and community-based facilities are unregulated as well as poorly managed, while overlapping service areas coexist with large gaps in coverage, according to the report. OECD also flagged substantial deficiencies in sanitation. About three million Filipinos use unimproved toilets, while four million still practice open defecation. Outside Metro Manila, piped sewerage remains limited, while the country has insufficient capacity to collect and treat fecal sludge despite the widespread use of on-site sanitation systems, the report said. OECD said most water service providers lack sufficient financial or technical capacity, or both, to provide the services needed by the country’s growing population. While commercial financing is available to creditworthy utilities, many providers cannot tap such funding because of weak financial viability, governance problems, and limited institutional capacity, according to the report. Tariff-setting is another problem constraining investment. OECD said many local government unit (LGU)-run utilities do not charge rates sufficient for full cost recovery, while some cannot even recover operations and maintenance (O&M) expenses, consequently relying on government subsidies. The report noted that tariff decisions for LGU-run utilities are made by local boards, while electoral considerations can weigh on decisions to increase rates. OECD recommended progressively harmonizing tariff methodologies while balancing financial sustainability and investment requirements with affordability as well as service quality. However, the report cautioned that tariffs alone cannot meet all policy objectives, with targeted subsidies or public funding needed in many cases to address social objectives. The report also highlighted proposed legislation that would establish a Department of Water Resources (DWR) as a new sector policy-making body and a Water Regulatory Commission (WRC) as a consolidated economic regulator amid the currently fragmented institutional framework governing the sector. OECD said consolidating economic regulation under the proposed WRC could help harmonize currently inconsistent tariff-setting regimes and establish comparable performance data across providers. OECD also recommended consolidating or clustering water and sanitation providers where appropriate to improve economies of scale, financial sustainability, as well as investment capacity. Aggregation could take several forms, including cooperation among LGUs, shared infrastructure, mergers or expansion of water districts, as well as private-sector participation through joint ventures (JVs), concessions, and bulk-water public-private partnerships (PPPs), according to the report. OECD recommended using government grants, concessional lending, as well as other financing incentives to encourage multi-LGU and clustered projects, while ensuring that consolidation does not immediately result in excessive tariff increases. The report said the proposed DWR and WRC could play key roles in setting the vision, aligning incentives, and coordinating stakeholders in efforts to consolidate service delivery. It noted that establishing regional utilities may require amendments to existing laws or new legislation, potentially through the DWR and WRC. The report also called for a centralized national integrated water information system, saying fragmented databases, inconsistent reporting, and limited interoperability currently weaken regulation, investment planning, as well as evidence-based decision-making. In particular, OECD recommended standardized data collection and reporting, real-time monitoring, bulk metering, as well as greater public access to water-sector information. A national information system could eventually support tariff-setting, performance monitoring, investment prioritization, and climate-risk management, while investments in bulk metering and network monitoring could help reduce non-revenue water (NRW) as well as improve service reliability, according to the report.

ph.title: Analyst: GCash’s IPO success hings on post-listing value
ph.description: The success of Mynt Inc.’s initial public offering will depend on post-listing value creation and regional expansion rather than its initial ₱10 price ceiling, according to capital market analyst Jonathan Ravelas. The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) approved on Sept. 18 the listing application for the operator of digital wallet GCash, clearing the way for an offering of up to ₱92.3 billion. The transaction is set to become the largest stock market debut in Philippine history, surpassing Monde Nissin Corp.’s ₱55.9 billion offering in 2021. Ravelas said the ₱10 maximum offer price filed with regulators is a standard procedural ceiling designed to give the issuer operational flexibility throughout the transaction process. The figure represents neither a target price nor a guaranteed valuation, Ravelas said, noting that final pricing will be fixed through an institutional book-building process. Market demand, corporate fundamentals, and international peer comparisons will dictate the ultimate clearing price. For prospective investors, the key metric is whether the transaction attracts long-term institutional capital that can support share performance post-listing. Backed by Globe Telecom Inc., Ayala Corp., and Ant Group, the fintech firm has room for revenue growth as it expands from a basic digital payments app into a broader financial services platform. Mynt can further monetize its user base of more than 90 million registered accounts and 49 million active users through micro-lending, wealth management, cross-border remittance, and merchant acquisition services. The market debut allows retail users to transition from consumers to equity holders in the domestic digital economy. Department of Trade and Industry Secretary Cristina Roque said the digital infrastructure surrounding e-wallets also supports micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises preparing for cross-border commerce under the regional ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement. Under the terms approved by the exchange, Mynt is authorized to offer up to 1.61 billion primary common shares and 6.42 billion secondary common shares, with an overallotment option of up to 1.20 billion secondary shares. Primary proceeds are designated for tech infrastructure, product development, and general corporate purposes. Following regulatory clearance from the Securities and Exchange Commission, Mynt plans to set final pricing on Oct. 1, run its public offering from Oct. 6 to Oct. 12, and list on the main board under ticker GCASH on Oct. 20. Local retail investors can participate directly via the GStocks feature inside the GCash mobile app or through the online PSE EASy platform.

ph.description: Built on the financial-grade open-source agent platform openJiuwen and open compute infrastructure, Huawei builds Agent Factory, Token Factory, and Data-Knowledge Factory to accelerate production-grade agent deployment at scale. SHANGHAI , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- During HUAWEI CONNECT 2026, Huawei hosted a Global Finance Summit. The CRTV device that spots enemies hidden in your surroundings might slightly diminish the story’s ability to deliver major scares early on, but when Townfall eventually got me, it made sure it got me good. Like the intravenous needle permanently jutting out of its hero’s wrist, Silent Hill: Townfall gives this long running series a welcome shot in the arm."

pk.title: Huawei Launches the AI Practice LAB (AIPL) Solution, Setting a New Paradigm for "Education + AI" Talent Cultivation
pk.description: SHANGHAI , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- During HUAWEI CONNECT 2026, the Global Education Summit themed "AI × Education: Building the Talent Foundation for the Digital & Intelligent Era" was successfully held in Shanghai. At the summit, Huawei officially launched the AI Practice LAB (AIPL) Solution globally, and simultaneously released the "AI+ Practical Teaching White Paper" (referred to as the "White Paper"). As AI-driven education transformation gains momentum, the conventional theoretical teaching model can no longer meet the industry's demand for practical capabilities, making AI talent cultivation a top priority for higher education. Drawing on its extensive experience across various industries, Huawei has introduced the AIPL Solution, which is centered around real-world scenarios, real data, and real algorithms. This solution aims to bridge the gap between conventional theoretical teaching and industry needs by introducing real-world industry cases, anonymized data, and engineering tools into teaching practices, helping universities cultivate AI professionals who are truly aligned with industry needs. Tao Jingwen, Deputy Chairman of the Supervisory Board, Huawei, noted that together with the education sector and industry enterprises, Huawei have integrated AI technology to jointly deepen our exploration of practical education models. We have built "roads" and "bridges" in theoretical learning, practice, and scientific research innovation. Huawei will continue to remain deeply rooted in the education sector, adopting an open approach to collaborate with global universities, research institutions, and industry partners, empowering the digital and intelligent transformation of the education sector through technological innovation. Launch of the AIPL Solution At the summit, Li Junfeng, Vice President of Huawei and CEO of Global Public Sector BU; Pang Chuanchun, Director of Huawei's Learning & Certification Services Dept; He Lian, Vice President of Wuhan University; Xue Guangtao, Director of Network & Information Center of Shanghai Jiao Tong University jointly launched the Huawei AIPL Solution to the world. Currently, in collaboration with 12 baseline partners, the solution has been used to build AI practical teaching solutions and has been deployed at multiple universities, including Beijing Institute of Technology and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. This global launch aims to promote the concept and solution of AI practice worldwide, fostering the cultivation of AI innovation talents globally. At the summit, Huawei, together with multiple universities and partners, released the "AI+ Practical Teaching White Paper". Du Min, President of Huawei Higher Education BU; Sun Gang, Director of Huawei's ICT Talent Partner Development Dept; Zhang Jianjun, Vice President of Huawei; Bi Xiaohan, Deputy Director of UNESCO International Centre for Higher Education Innovation; Xia Zhengwei, Vice Director of Information Center of Wuhan University; Li Kangju, President of the Shenyang Institute of Technology and Lu Jie, Deputy Director of BGI College witnessed the release. The white paper systematically elaborates the theoretical logic and practical pathways for restructuring higher education talent cultivation paradigms in the AI era. Focusing on the core topic of "AI + practical teaching", it proposes a transformation reference framework featuring "one foundation, two types of elements, three levels of courses, four-dimensional evaluation, and a five-party ecosystem." This framework aims to provide a systematic, pragmatic, and actionable guide for university administrators, frontline teachers, education researchers, and industry professionals. Looking ahead, Huawei will continue to work closely with universities and partners to strengthen the digital and intelligent foundation of the education industry and promote the replication of the AIPL model across multiple disciplines. By empowering education with technology and cultivating talent through hands-on practice, Huawei will transform cutting-edge industry technologies and real-world business scenarios into educational resources for practical training, smart teaching, smart campus, and research innovation. In this way, high-quality educational resources will be more widely shared.

pk.title: Huawei Launches Fintelligent AI Solution to Help Global Financial Institutions Realize "Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence"
pk.description: Built on the financial-grade open-source agent platform openJiuwen and open compute infrastructure, Huawei builds Agent Factory, Token Factory, and Data-Knowledge Factory to accelerate production-grade agent deployment at scale. SHANGHAI , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- During HUAWEI CONNECT 2026, Huawei hosted a Global Finance Summit. Jason Cao, CEO of Huawei Digital Finance BU, delivered a keynote titled "Owning Your AI, Advancing Agentic Banking," presenting the proposition "Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence" to global financial customers and launching the Huawei Fintelligent AI Solution worldwide. The solution focuses on key challenges facing large-scale AI deployment in the global financial industry, including security, scalability, and sustainability. It helps financial institutions build a new capability system and, through three intelligent factories — Agent Factory, Token Factory, and Data-Knowledge Factory — continuously build and evolve their enterprise AI architecture, one-stop agent foundation, banking domain intelligence, and full-lifecycle Token operations, accelerating the transition to Agentic Finance. Jason Cao said, "Competition in financial AI is shifting from model capability to enterprise-wide AI system capability. Every financial institution should own its AI and keep the choice and evolution of AI in its own hands. Truly owning your AI is not about using a particular model or deploying a few AI applications. It means being able to choose independently, operate securely, replicate at scale, and continuously evolve your AI capabilities. Through open architecture, platforms, and compute, Huawei will work with customers and partners to bring AI at scale into core business operations and accelerate the transition to Agentic Finance." Jason Cao, CEO of Huawei Digital Finance BU Agent Factory scales AI into an enterprise-wide capability; Token Factory delivers a better price-performance ratio and sustainable full-lifecycle Token management; and Data-Knowledge Factory accumulates knowledge assets to enable financial institutions to build intelligence as an internal capability. Together, the three intelligent factories connect data, knowledge, Tokens, and agent capabilities. Agent Factory focuses on helping banks build, run, and manage agents at scale, enabling AI capabilities to move from isolated applications to enterprise-wide intelligence while supporting the accumulation, reuse, and unified management of agent assets. openJiuwen is an open-source agent platform designed for multi-agent collaboration, with enterprise-grade reliability and compute affinity. Built on a financial-grade production kernel, it provides three core capabilities: stable long-running operations, financial-grade components, and one-stop development and operations. openJiuwen provides a unified enterprise foundation, enabling financial institutions to build, run, manage, and govern agents on the same agent platform. Huawei launched TokeNexus, a full-lifecycle Token operations solution covering Token planning, efficient production, intelligent scheduling, and global optimization, enabling unified operations and management across the entire Token lifecycle. Through end-to-end integrated governance, TokeNexus helps financial institutions scale AI while keeping costs controllable, performance reliable, and supply sustainable. Huawei proposes the Data-Knowledge Factory, which transforms bank data, documents, and rules into knowledge that agents can understand, trust, and invoke, gradually accumulating it into each bank's own Domain Intelligence. At the summit, Huawei launched the Financial Agentic Data Solution. Centered on data and knowledge pipelines, the solution provides financial agents with high-quality data and knowledge, allowing high-value data and knowledge to flow continuously to agents. Building on this evolution, the Data-Knowledge Factory establishes a systematic upgrade path from data supply to knowledge supply. Huawei's AI Coding Solution adopts an ontology-centric approach to transform valuable business rules hidden in legacy-system code into reusable knowledge assets that AI can understand and use, accelerating core modernization. At the summit, Huawei also joined representatives from banking, insurance, securities, and industry partners to unveil the 2026 Huawei Global Financial Lighthouse, highlighting nine lighthouse practices and providing reference cases for digital and intelligent transformation across the global financial industry. Huawei has been deeply engaged in the financial industry for 16 years. To date, it has served more than 7,100 financial customers across over 80 countries and regions, including 54 of the world's top 100 banks.

ae.title: Huawei Launches Fintelligent AI Solution to Help Global Financial Institutions Realize "Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence"
ae.description: Built on the financial-grade open-source agent platform openJiuwen and open compute infrastructure, Huawei builds Agent Factory, Token Factory, and Data-Knowledge Factory to accelerate production-grade agent deployment at scale. SHANGHAI , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- During HUAWEI CONNECT 2026, Huawei hosted a Global Finance Summit. Jason Cao, CEO of Huawei Digital Finance BU, delivered a keynote titled "Owning Your AI, Advancing Agentic Banking," presenting the proposition "Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence" to global financial customers and launching the Huawei Fintelligent AI Solution worldwide. The solution focuses on key challenges facing large-scale AI deployment in the global financial industry, including security, scalability, and sustainability. It helps financial institutions build a new capability system and, through three intelligent factories — Agent Factory, Token Factory, and Data-Knowledge Factory — continuously build and evolve their enterprise AI architecture, one-stop agent foundation, banking domain intelligence, and full-lifecycle Token operations, accelerating the transition to Agentic Finance. Jason Cao said, "Competition in financial AI is shifting from model capability to enterprise-wide AI system capability. Every financial institution should own its AI and keep the choice and evolution of AI in its own hands. Truly owning your AI is not about using a particular model or deploying a few AI applications. It means being able to choose independently, operate securely, replicate at scale, and continuously evolve your AI capabilities. Through open architecture, platforms, and compute, Huawei will work with customers and partners to bring AI at scale into core business operations and accelerate the transition to Agentic Finance." Jason Cao, CEO of Huawei Digital Finance BU Agent Factory scales AI into an enterprise-wide capability; Token Factory delivers a better price-performance ratio and sustainable full-lifecycle Token management; and Data-Knowledge Factory accumulates knowledge assets to enable financial institutions to build intelligence as an internal capability. Together, the three intelligent factories connect data, knowledge, Tokens, and agent capabilities. Agent Factory focuses on helping banks build, run, and manage agents at scale, enabling AI capabilities to move from isolated applications to enterprise-wide intelligence while supporting the accumulation, reuse, and unified management of agent assets. openJiuwen is an open-source agent platform designed for multi-agent collaboration, with enterprise-grade reliability and compute affinity. Built on a financial-grade production kernel, it provides three core capabilities: stable long-running operations, financial-grade components, and one-stop development and operations. openJiuwen provides a unified enterprise foundation, enabling financial institutions to build, run, manage, and govern agents on the same agent platform. Huawei launched TokeNexus, a full-lifecycle Token operations solution covering Token planning, efficient production, intelligent scheduling, and global optimization, enabling unified operations and management across the entire Token lifecycle. Through end-to-end integrated governance, TokeNexus helps financial institutions scale AI while keeping costs controllable, performance reliable, and supply sustainable. Huawei proposes the Data-Knowledge Factory, which transforms bank data, documents, and rules into knowledge that agents can understand, trust, and invoke, gradually accumulating it into each bank's own Domain Intelligence. At the summit, Huawei launched the Financial Agentic Data Solution. Centered on data and knowledge pipelines, the solution provides financial agents with high-quality data and knowledge, allowing high-value data and knowledge to flow continuously to agents. Building on this evolution, the Data-Knowledge Factory establishes a systematic upgrade path from data supply to knowledge supply. Huawei's AI Coding Solution adopts an ontology-centric approach to transform valuable business rules hidden in legacy-system code into reusable knowledge assets that AI can understand and use, accelerating core modernization. At the summit, Huawei also joined representatives from banking, insurance, securities, and industry partners to unveil the 2026 Huawei Global Financial Lighthouse, highlighting nine lighthouse practices and providing reference cases for digital and intelligent transformation across the global financial industry. Huawei has been deeply engaged in the financial industry for 16 years. To date, it has served more than 7,100 financial customers across over 80 countries and regions, including 54 of the world's top 100 banks.

ae.title: Arctech Earns 2026 EcoVadis Silver Medal, Placing Among Top 15% Globally
ae.description: KUNSHAN, China , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Arctech has been awarded a Silver Medal in the 2026 EcoVadis Sustainability Rating, placing the company among the top 15% of companies assessed by EcoVadis globally. The recognition reflects Arctech's continued efforts to strengthen sustainability management and integrate environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles into its business and operations. Arctech receives the EcoVadis Silver Medal in the 2026 Sustainability Rating. EcoVadis assesses companies across four key sustainability themes: Environment, Labor & Human Rights, Ethics, and Sustainable Procurement. Its medals are awarded based on a company's percentile ranking among companies assessed globally over the previous 12 months, with the Silver Medal corresponding to the top 15%. Guided by its development approach of "globalization, differentiation, sustainability and intelligence", Arctech continues to advance ESG integration across its operations and business activities. On the environmental front, Arctech combines sustainable solutions with ongoing efforts to improve the environmental performance of its own operations. Through its "Tracker+" and "Green Power+" solutions, the company integrates solar tracking, flexible cable mounting, intelligent O&M, smart installation and energy storage to support diverse applications and the evolving needs of the energy transition. In 2025, Arctech invested RMB 4.3629 million (approximately US$651,000) in environmental protection. Its self-owned photovoltaic power stations generated more than 34 million kWh of electricity, accounting for 24% of its total electricity consumption. The company also continued to expand renewable energy use, improve energy efficiency across its facilities, and apply digital and intelligent technologies in manufacturing, saving 364,000 kWh of electricity annually. Beyond its environmental efforts, Arctech continues to strengthen its social and governance practices. The company holds certifications including ISO 45001, SA8000 and ISO 37001, supporting its efforts in occupational health and safety, employee rights and business ethics. The EcoVadis Silver Medal recognizes Arctech's progress to date and provides further momentum for continuous improvement. Looking ahead, Arctech will continue to deepen ESG integration, advance greener operations and sustainable solutions, and work with customers and partners to support the global energy transition. Learn more about Arctech's EcoVadis recognition and rating here: https://recognition.ecovadis.com/Zgy7ZWux8Ee9SsK-w693XA About Arctech For more information about Arctech, visit: https://en.arctechsolar.com/

ae.title: St. John Names Humberto Leon Creative Director
ae.description: SHANGHAI , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lanvin Group (NYSE: LANV, the "Group"), a global luxury fashion group, today announced that Humberto Leon has been named Creative Director of St. John. Leon co-founded the influential fashion and retail concept Opening Ceremony with Carol Lim in 2002. From 2011 to 2019, the pair served as Creative Directors of Kenzo, bringing a bold, contemporary identity to the French fashion house. Before joining St. John, Leon served as Creative Director of KATSEYE, overseeing the global girl group's visual identity and image. Leon's appointment marks a new chapter for St. John, building on the brand's nearly 65-year heritage while bringing a fresh perspective to its signatures, including knitwear, sportswear and jewelry. The partnership reflects a shared California sensibility, respect for craftsmanship and belief in clothing that feels as good as it looks. About Lanvin Group Lanvin Group is a leading global luxury fashion group headquartered in Shanghai, China and Milan, Italy, managing iconic brands worldwide including Lanvin, Wolford, Sergio Rossi and St. John Knits. Harnessing the power of its unique strategic alliance of industry-leading partners in the luxury fashion sector, Lanvin Group strives to expand the global footprint of its portfolio brands and achieve sustainable growth through strategic investment and extensive operational know-how, combined with an understanding and access to the fastest-growing luxury fashion markets in the world. The shares of Lanvin Group are listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "LANV". For more information about Lanvin Group, please visit www.lanvin-group.com , and to view Lanvin Group's investor presentation, please visit https://ir.lanvin-group.com . ae.title: Probiotic Medical Food* NeuralliTM MP Sweeps Double Award Win in Hong Kong: Over 90% of Healthcare Professionals Back the Brand
ae.description: Building on Its Global Momentum, the Brand Completes Official HSA Notification in Singapore and Secures Full HSA/FSA Payment Support in the US HONG KONG , Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bened Life, a global leader in psychobiotic innovation, saw its flagship product NeuralliTM MP win two authoritative industry and medical honors in Hong Kong. At the Healthcare Professionals Favorite Brand Award 2026, NeuralliTM MP stood out among numerous probiotic brands to win the top honor in the Probiotics category, the " Healthcare Professional Choice Probiotic Award ." Separately, in 2025, NeuralliTM MP was further honored with the Best Psychobiotic Brand of the Year award , presented by the Hong Kong Commercial Times (HKCT), underscoring the brand's leading position in the psychobiotics field. Behind these two honors lies real-world validation from the healthcare professional community. A survey by the Health Research Centre among HK healthcare professionals shows that after 1 month of NeuralliTM MP usage: Over 90% of surveyed HK HCPs recommend1 94.3% of surveyed HK HCPs reported improved focus2 93.1% of surveyed HK HCPs reported reduced work stress3 "These two awards mean a lot to us — they reflect real recognition from Hong Kong's healthcare community and business sector alike, for our scientific evidence and quality standards," said Frankie Cheng, CEO of Bened Life. "But for a science-driven brand like ours, nothing means more than earning the trust of frontline healthcare professionals." As public awareness of Brain-Gut Axis health keeps growing, NeuralliTM MP continues to earn trust across Hong Kong and the wider APAC market through its strong scientific evidence and high quality standards. At the core of NeuralliTM MP is PS128TM ( Lactiplantibacillus plantarum PS128TM), a probiotic strain extensively studied for its role in the gut-brain connection. PS128TM is a novel psychobiotic that appears to balance the "happy hormones" serotonin and dopamine, the "stress hormone" cortisol, and other molecules that affect neurological health, mood, stress response, and focus. Backed by more than 18 clinical studies , PS128TM continues to be studied for how it may support this connection between gut health and overall wellbeing. At the same time, the brand has reported good news in other key markets: NeuralliTM MP has officially completed notification with Singapore's Health Sciences Authority (HSA) as a notified health supplement (VNS Notification No.: VNS-2026-08-00377), and now offers full support for Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) payments in the US market, allowing local consumers to purchase the product using pre-tax health benefit funds. These international milestones echo the professional recognition earned in Hong Kong, together reinforcing the brand's leading position in global Brain-Gut Axis research. Looking ahead, Bened Life will continue to deepen its local presence and scientific outreach across the APAC region, providing consumers worldwide with psychobiotic solutions backed by scientific research and high quality standards, and leading new trends in global brain and mental wellness. About Bened Life Bened Life is a US-based leader in psychobiotics, focused on Gut-Brain Axis research. The company is committed to developing the world's first medical-grade Gut-Brain Axis probiotic solutions, grounded in scientific evidence and clinical data. Its flagship product, NeuralliTM MP, features the patented strain PS128TM, supported by 18 clinical studies , and is sold in over 60 countries and regions worldwide. Guided by its mission of "science-driven health," Bened Life continues to expand its presence in core markets including the US and Asia-Pacific, while actively investing in neurodiversity initiatives and research collaborations, committed to providing consumers worldwide with trustworthy mental wellness supplements. iq.description: شفق نيوز- النجف نعى المرجع الديني الأعلى علي السيستاني، يوم الاثنين، المرجع الديني موسى الشبيري الزنجاني، الذي توفي في مدينة قم الإيرانية عن عمر ناهز 98 عاماً، واصفاً رحيله بـ"المصاب الأليم والخسارة العظيمة". وقال السيستاني في بيان نعي، صدر عن مكتبه ورد إلى وكالة شفق نيوز، إن الزنجاني "أمضى عمره بأسره في سبيل التحقيق والتعليم"، مشيراً إلى أنه كان من كبار العلماء ومن أعمدة الحوزة العلمية في قم، ومن أبرز مصاديق المرجع العالم الرباني. وأضاف أن "آثاره العلمية القيّمة، وسائر خدماته الدينية، تمثل إرثاً نفيساً وخالداً"، وأن سيرته ومنهجه العملي سيبقيان "نموذجاً فريداً يُحتذى به للعلماء". إلى ذلك أعلنت الحوزة العلمية الدينية في النجف الحداد وتعطيل دروسها على وفاة المرجع الديني موسى الزنجاني. والشبيري الزنجاني، المولود في قم عام 1928، من أبرز المرجعيات الدينية الشيعية في إيران، ودرس العلوم الدينية في حوزة قم على يد عدد من كبار علمائها، كما درس في حوزة النجف على يد أبي القاسم الخوئي ومحسن الحكيم وعبد الهادي الحسيني الشيرازي. وأقام الزنجاني في قم، حيث واصل التدريس في حوزتها، واشتهر بخبرته في علم الرجال، كما كان يؤم الصلاة في مرقد السيدة فاطمة المعصومة. وتوفي الزنجاني، فجر الاثنين 21 أيلول 2026، في قم عن عمر ناهز 98 عاماً، بعد تعرضه لعارض صحي رئوي أُدخل على إثره إلى المستشفى في 18 أيلول.

iq.description: شفق نيوز- بغداد نعت نقابة الفنانين العراقيين، رحيل النحات العراقي هادي عباس، الذي وافته المنية اليوم الاثنين، معربة عن أملها أن يلهم ذويه ومحبيه وزملاءه الصبر والسلوان. ويعد الراحل، من الفنانين الذين واظبوا على تجاربهم بإخلاص شديد للفن لسنوات طويلة، منذ تخرجه في أكاديمية الفنون الجميلة ببغداد عام 1967 وحتى وفاته. وكان هادي عباس، قد تدرب في سنته الأولى على الخزف على يد الفنان القبرصي الكبير فالانتينوس، مؤسس قسم الخزف في الأكاديمية، قبل أن ينتقل إلى قسم النحت ويتتلمذ على يد النحات الكبير محمد غني حكمت، ويزامله ويعمل معه لاحقًا. وشارك عباس مع مجموعة من النحاتين في تأسيس "جماعة ألوان للنحاتين العراقيين"، إلى جانب الراحلين النحات اتحاد كريم والنحات عبد الرحيم الحسان، وكذلك النحات ليث فتاح الترك والنحات خالد المبارك. كما أسس أول جمعية للخزف في بغداد، وقد أبدع في مختلف اختصاصات الفن التشكيلي، من نحت وخزف ورسم، بالفاعلية ذاتها وبإمكانات أدائية متطورة. كما أقام الراحل، ثلاثة معارض شخصية، فضلًا عن مشاركاته العديدة في المعارض الجماعية والمشتركة داخل البلاد وخارجها، وله الكثير من المقتنيات في أماكن مختلفة، وما زال يمارس عمله بهمة الشباب.

zm.title: Bree & Clint are running a half marathon... with ZERO training
zm.description: Bree & Clint have decided to run a half marathon with absolutely no training In a move that has shocked fitness experts, concerned friends, and honestly... themselves, Bree & Clint have announced they're taking on a half marathon despite doing approximately zero training. The idea came after the pair discovered that music producer Benny Blanco completed a half marathon after making the decision during a late-night drinking session. Naturally, instead of seeing this as a unique and slightly alarming achievement, Bree & Clint saw it as inspiration. "How hard can it be?" is reportedly the level of research that has gone into their preparation so far. View this post on Instagram A post shared by ZM's Bree & Clint (@breeandclint) The challenge isn't a full marathon, let's be clear. It's a half marathon, which is still a perfectly reasonable 21.1 kilometres of continuous running. For context, that's a distance many people spend months training for. Bree & Clint are spending days. After publicly committing to the challenge, the pair sought advice from experienced marathon runner Brodie Kane. Unfortunately for them, the feedback wasn't exactly encouraging. According to Brodie, their plan is, in professional terms, "idiotic" and it's probably going to hurt. A lot. To make matters even more chaotic, the duo plan to run laps around Auckland's Victoria Park rather than tackling a scenic point-to-point course. Their reasoning? If things go badly, they'll never be too far from the radio station... or the pub. Honestly, that's the most Bree & Clint thing we've ever heard. Whether they cross the finish line looking triumphant or are found negotiating with an Uber halfway through remains to be seen, but one thing is certain: we'll be following every painful step of the journey. And if they somehow pull this off, expect every person who's ever walked past a gym and thought "yeah, I could probably do that" to become unbearably confident. Good luck, Bree & Clint.
